prompt: Pick one active employee who has a LeaveBalance row. Put every LeaveBalance for that person in findings.leave_balances (include leave_balance_id, leave_type, balance_days, used_days). Compare to LeaveType annual_entitlement when LeaveType.list has rows; if LeaveType is empty, put that gap in uncertain and do not invent entitlements. Leave on_leave / attendance_flags / confirmation_due empty unless directly relevant.
